# llx

> llx is the agent runtime other agents build on, one binary under 4 MB. It runs three ways from one
> binary: `llx`, a minimal agent at the terminal with six tools; `llx exec`, one task for scripts
> and CI (JSON events, `--schema` answers, exit codes as a contract); and `llx decide`, a quick
> choice about stdin. It works with any model of the models.dev catalog and runs on macOS and Linux.

## Install

- `npm install -g @localixai/llx`, or `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsaryev/llx/main/scripts/install.sh | sh` (macOS and Linux x86_64, checked against `SHA256SUMS`).
- Sign in with `/login` in a session (`llx`), or set the provider's key (for example `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`).

## Use

- `llx` opens a session at the terminal; `llx "<task>"` opens one that starts with that task.
- `llx exec "<task>"` (or `llx -p "<task>"`) runs one task and exits: the answer alone on stdout.
- `llx exec --json` prints one JSON event per line; `--schema` ends with data matching a JSON Schema.
- `llx decide "<question>"` asks the decision model one question about stdin and prints the option it picked (`--choices`, `--expect`).
- Exit codes: 0 achieved, 1 not achieved, 2 out of turns or time, 3 environment or usage, 130 interrupted.

## In CI

- `uses: rsaryev/llx@v0` is a GitHub Action: it installs llx, runs `llx exec` once, and returns the answer, the exit code and the cost.
- The agent works through the shell (`gh`, `git`, `jq` and the project's own tools): no MCP server, no GitHub tool, no built-in prompt. The workflow owns the prompt and the posting.
- The job that runs the model holds a read-only token; a second job, with write access and no model key, posts what it answered.
- Guide: https://llx.sh/docs/ci. Recipes: https://llx.sh/docs/recipes. Ready-made workflows: https://llx.sh/docs/examples.

## From another agent

- `llx exec` hands a task to a helper on any provider and model; `llx decide` answers a quick choice about stdin.
- Guide: https://llx.sh/docs/agents.

## Links

- Docs: https://llx.sh/docs (each page is listed below; all of them in one file: https://llx.sh/llms-full.txt)
